Sir Bernard Rowland Crick (16 December 1929 – 19 December 2008) [ 2 ] was a British political theorist and democratic socialist whose views can be summarised as "politics is ethics done in public". He sought to arrive at a "politics of action", as opposed to a "politics of thought" or of ideology, and he held that "political power is power in the subjunctive mood ." [ 3 ] He was a leading critic of behaviouralism .
